approvedExceptions.reason: GDS governs chart framing, state handling, action placement, and mobile hierarchy, but the chart engine itself remains outside first-class GDS ownership.
approvedExceptions.allowedImplementation: Use Recharts only for visualization primitives while keeping card framing, labels, legends, empty states, and responsive hierarchy inside GDS-governed layout primitives.
approvedExceptions.mustStillUse: GDS cards, section panels, toolbars, state blocks, and spacing rules must continue to frame every chart surface.
approvedExceptions.mustNotDo: Do not introduce a parallel chart design language, raw page-local dashboard chrome, or bespoke token systems outside GDS.
approvedExceptions.exitCondition: Remove this exception only if GDS ships a first-class governed chart engine contract that replaces direct Recharts usage.

approvedExceptions.reason: Professional reports, family reports, governance bundles, and print-perfect document output remain product-authored export surfaces outside the runtime GDS component layer.
approvedExceptions.allowedImplementation: Generate export documents with product-owned rendering utilities while keeping in-app export entry points, state notices, and action placement governed by GDS components.
approvedExceptions.mustStillUse: All interactive export controls, consent gates, retry states, and audit-related notices must remain built from GDS primitives.
approvedExceptions.mustNotDo: Do not recreate an in-app parallel component library inside export code or treat static PDF layout logic as product UI runtime authority.
approvedExceptions.exitCondition: Remove this exception only if GDS adds a sanctioned document-rendering contract that covers printable report generation.

approvedExceptions.reason: KIDEX still uses a reviewed thin adapter around Mantine Select for searchable/addable selection flows until GDS ships a canonical searchable-selection contract.
approvedExceptions.allowedImplementation: Keep a single thin adapter that normalizes searchable/addable selection props onto Mantine Select/Combobox behavior without introducing custom design tokens or layout primitives.
approvedExceptions.mustStillUse: Labels, field framing, helper/error messaging, spacing, and surrounding form layout must continue to come from GDS-governed form contracts.
approvedExceptions.mustNotDo: Do not expand this adapter into a local component family, custom combobox styling system, or per-page selection variants.
approvedExceptions.exitCondition: Remove this exception once GDS publishes a canonical searchable-selection component or contract export and KIDEX migrates to it.
